wiring_gap_found.primary: agent._player_position and _bump_player_cells hardcoded the player as ARC avatar color 2. The live ls20 board (64x64) has NO color-2 cell: the player renders as color {9,12} (the dev program flood-fills the player from the color-12 object linked to a color-9 object). So _player_position returned None on every live frame, _bump_contexts returned [], _bump_discovery returned None, and the Run-22 bump quota fired 0 bumps SILENTLY across runs 17-22 while every color-2 toy test stayed green. Proven from artifacts: the run-15 transition suite's live grid colors are {0,1,3,4,5,8,9,11,12} - no 2.
wiring_gap_found.secondary_found_live_on_run_23: The first fix (infer player colors from the ACTIVE program by diffing rendered states) fell back to {2} LIVE because the ls20 program renders everything except the player as the UNKNOWN sentinel; int(UNKNOWN) raised out of the color-collection loop and discarded the whole set. Run-23's new diagnostics caught it exactly as designed: bump_skip_reason='no player cell on live grid (player_colors=[2])', bump_due_batches=21, bump_empty_batches=21. Fixed with a per-cell guard (skip UNKNOWN/non-int cells only); verified offline against the REAL dev-repaired ls20 program + REAL live grid: inferred colors [9,12], player found at (11,35).
wiring_gap_found.config_wiring: live_run's AgentConfig(...) passes only game_id/max_turns/synth_llm/artifacts_dir/graph_synthesis; every exploration knob reaches the agent via dataclass DEFAULTS (bump_probes=True, bump_quota_fraction=0.4, coverage_persistence=True). No field was dropped this time - proven by the new config_echo - but a future non-default field WOULD drop silently; now guarded by the config echo + a regression test through the real live_run constructor.
wiring_gap_found.divergences_counter_mislabeled: driver.live_run maps 'divergences' to summary.reactive_turns (driver.py line ~679), NOT expect-mismatches. Run 22's divergences=24 with live_pass_rate 1.0 is therefore consistent: 24 reactive turns, zero model misses. repair_attempts=6 with live 1.0 is the repair_sanity_cap pattern off transient divergence signatures (same shape as runs 15-17).

silent_drop_guards_added.config_echo: run summary now carries the EFFECTIVE knob values (bump_probes, bump_quota_fraction, bump_probe_repeats, exploration_min_bump_actions, coverage_persistence, coverage_plateau_exhaust, interaction_discovery, exploration_executor, graph_synthesis) plus the inferred player_colors - a dropped field is visible forever.
silent_drop_guards_added.bump_diagnostics: bump_due_batches / bump_empty_batches / bump_skip_reason (no player | no contexts | no movement action | unreachable | deduped) - a quota that is due but fires nothing is never invisible again.
